title: Dice3D — reusable animated die component
brief: Abstract the dice-roll animation (reference: codepen.io/jico 3D Dice with CSS; project already has the wizard DieCard and the artboard-09 diceShake) into ONE reusable component for the whole site: d6 as a real 3D CSS cube tumbling to its landing face, a chip variant for 1D16, states (rest/rolling/result), reduced-motion fallback. Mobile-first 390px, rulebook-light tokens. v2: user approved the d6 as-is (L110); added a size slider (scale-based size prop) and a true 3D D16 as an octagonal bipyramid (16 triangular faces).

artboards.title: Dice3D
artboards.tradeoff: True 3D cube for d6 (the reference's charm) + honest chip for d16; two visual families to keep until a single-geometry solution exists

artboards.title: Dice3D 16 — octaedro octogonal
artboards.tradeoff: A real 16-face polyhedron (8+8 triangles) in CSS 3D with the jico glass look; denser geometry than the cube, numbers of back faces show through the glass

artboards.title: D16 · 5 resaltados del resultado
artboards.tradeoff: Five competing result-highlight styles for the 16-face die (A red-halo, B layer pulse, C floating badge, D spotlight, E border flash) selectable live; C is the most visible from afar, A/D keep the die itself as the hero
